content_text:
Hello everyone,
I am shooting a “see through” glass bottle outside, on a beach in a few weeks. It is going to be a very small team and mainly me on the lighting front.
I am planning for a few items to help me, notably white and black cards, a couple of diffusion frames, a reflector (gold and white) and a nano push light or dedo light.
I was wondering if there is anything specific I should watch out for? Some issue that you can easily get with a see through bottle?
Thank you
Claire
